The whole model is on the slides. Nothing held back:

1. Pick an offer that pays every month, not once. Ask three things: does it pay monthly, do you use it yourself, and is the cookie at least 30 days?

2. Pick ONE format. Screen recording, text on video, or AI voiceover list. Repeat it until it feels boring.

3. Post every day. Most posts do nothing — that's normal, not failure. Volume is how you find the winner.

4. Do more of what worked. Drop the rest. Pay-once covers the post. Monthly covers everything you already made.

The part people get wrong: adding a second offer before the first one works. That's not diversifying. That's quitting slowly.
